items.headline: Bucs down Falcons without pass completion; Bucky Irving, Kenny Gainwell run wild
items.description: Baker Mayfield didn't complete a pass but the Buccaneers beat the Falcons 16-0 behind Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell's rushing on a wet, sloppy field.

items.headline: Buccaneers beat Falcons 16-0 despite failing to complete a single pass in wet, sloppy conditions
items.description: — Baker Mayfield didn’t complete a pass but the Tampa Bay Buccaneers beat the Atlanta Falcons 16-0 on Sunday behind Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell's rushing on a wet, sloppy field.
